Preparation Suggestion

-Caramel Popcorn-


Ingredients:
1 cup butter
2 cups brown sugar
1/2 cup corn syrup
1 teaspoon salt
1/2 teaspoon baking soda
1 teaspoon vanilla extract
5 quarts popped popcorn


Method:


1- Preheat oven to 250 degrees F (95 degrees C). Place popcorn in a very large bowl.

2-In a medium saucepan over medium heat, melt butter. Stir in brown sugar, corn syrup and salt. Bring to a boil, stirring constantly. Boil without stirring 4 minutes. Remove from heat and stir in soda and vanilla. Pour in a thin stream over popcorn, stirring to coat.


3-Place in two large shallow baking dishes and bake in preheated oven, stirring every 15 minutes, for 1 hour. Remove from oven and let cool completely before breaking into pieces.


Storage instructions:

Always store in dry, cool place away from sunlight and any sources of pollution and chemicals, in low temperature that doesn't exceed 20°.

description:
Handmade Artisan Toffee Popcorn

ToffeePop toffee covered popcorn is one of Northwest Expressions most requested gourmet confections, and is handmade by mixing our own signature Butter Crunch Almond Toffee, petite peanuts and fluffy mushroom popped corn. Betcha can’t eat just one handful!

It all starts with a 20” x 16” copper kettle over an open flame, and an old fashioned recipe using only the highest quality, all natural ingredients. The fresh sweet cream butter, pure sugars and roasted almonds are all slowly heated to the perfect temperature to create a gourmet toffee that is then added to peanuts and popcorn…and voila! ToffeePop popcorn! Our toffee popcorn is handmade with kosher dairy products, and gluten free, all natural ingredients, and we don’t skimp – each popcorn kernel is thoroughly coated with toffee crunch goodness.

Gourmet Gift Choice

Why not deliver the gourmet taste of homemade toffee popcorn to your friends and family? Hand crafting our confectionery using a small batch process ensures that old fashioned, homemade ‘melt in your mouth crunch’ and distinctive artisanal flavor of a truly handmade toffee popcorn, and an elegant resealable gallon canister keeps your popcorn in perfect condition.

Northwest Expressions

Crafting gourmet expressions influenced by the taste, feel and rich history of the Pacific Northwest, Northwest Expressions creates small batch artisan chocolates, cookies and confections made by hand and with love on Harstine Island in Washington State, USA. Our roots run deep. Rick’s Grandma Carrie’s original 1950’s handwritten recipe for Soft Peanut Butter Brittle still hangs in our kitchen. Though a bit tattered, it is framed now to preserve the recipe we still use to this very day.

description:
BETTER MADE SPECIAL POTATO CHIPS HISTORY
Cross and Peters company was founded on August 1st, 1930. The company was named after the founders' first names, Cross and Peter. Both set goals to make a better potato chip, hence the brand name: Better Made Potato Chips

Better Made became not only a brand name but a way of doing business. Even in the early days of the company, only the best ingredients and methods were used. At first, production was simple. Burlap bagged, select potatoes were cooked in the best oil available, weighed, and hand packed into crude, greaseless bags. Distribution was chiefly through the company's own store outlets, which later grew into small delivery routes.

OUR PROCESS TODAY
Today, Better Made uses 60 million pounds of chip potatoes every year and the entire process is a little more complex. The potatoes are purchased in bulk (45,000 to 85,000 pounds per truck load) and unloaded from delivery trucks which are lifted by a hydraulic lift. The potatoes are then transported by conveyors to storage bins. As needed the potatoes are automatically conveyed to the fryers where they are washed, peeled, sliced, and inspected. Next, the potato slices are conveyed to temperature-controlled cookers where only 100% cottonseed oil is used. The cooked chips are then lightly salted and automatically advanced by an overhead vibrating conveyor system to automatic packaging machines that weigh, form, fill, and seal the finished bags.

Better Made's over 85 years of progress have all been made in Detroit, using Michigan potatoes for ten months of the year and drawing from Mother Nature's harvest schedule in Florida, Missouri, Indiana, North Dakota, Minnesota, or wherever the best potatoes are available for the remainder of the year.

description:
Back when Dan and I first started popping popcorn in our Mankato garage, we wanted to teach our kids the value of hard work and have a little fun along the way. We also wanted a snack we felt good about feeding them. Hugely flavorful snacks made with real, simple ingredients -- you know, ingredients you don’t have to scrunch up your face to say. Snacks packed with positivity, not guilt. Snacks that keep the joy in everyday snacking (and snacking and snacking…). With bright bags that radiate all the love and fun that went into them from the beginning. After all, isn’t that what snacking should be about? We couldn’t agree more. Enjoy. XO, Angie The real kind. Creamy, tangy, “cow’s-gift-to-humanity” cheesy. Made with the fewest, finest, real food ingredients possible, including a White Cheddar that’s good enough to bring home to dinner. After all, everything’s better with cheese.

Cuando Dan y yo empezamos a hacer popcorn en nuestro garaje Mankato, queríamos enseñar a nuestros hijos el valor del trabajo duro y divertirnos un poco. También queríamos un aperitivo que nos sentimos bien al alimentarlos. Refrigerios muy sabrosos elaborados con ingredientes reales y sencillos. Ya sabes, ingredientes que no tienes que agitar tu cara para decirlo. Snacks llenos de positividad, no culpa. Aperitivos que mantienen la alegría en los bocadillos diarios (y bocadillos y aperitivos…). Con bolsas brillantes que irradian todo el amor y la diversión que entró en ellos desde el principio. Después de todo, ¿no es eso de lo que debería ser la merienda? No podríamos estar más de acuerdo. Disfrutar. XO, Angie El verdadero tipo. Cremoso, picante, "vaca-regalo-a la humanidad" cursi. Elaborado con los menos ingredientes alimenticios más reales posibles, incluyendo un Cheddar blanco que es lo suficientemente bueno para llevar a casa a la cena. Después de todo, todo es mejor con queso.

כשדן ואני התחלנו לקפוץ פופקורן במוסך Mankato שלנו, רצינו ללמד את הילדים שלנו את הערך של עבודה קשה וליהנות קצת לאורך הדרך. רצינו גם חטיף שהרגשנו טוב לגבי האכילה. חטיפים טעימים מאוד העשויים מרכיבים אמיתיים ופשוטים -- אתם יודעים, מרכיבים שאתם לא צריכים לגרד את הפנים שלכם כדי לומר. חטיפים מלאים בחיוביות, לא אשמה. חטיפים ששומרים על השמחה בנטיפים יומיומיים (וחטיפים וחטיפים..). עם תיקים בהירים המקרינים את כל האהבה והכיף שנכנסו אליהם מההתחלה. אחרי הכל, האם זה לא מה שיש לחטיפים לעלות? לא הצלחנו להסכים יותר. תהנה. XO, Angie The real kind. גבינה קרמית, חריפה, "פרה-מתנה לאנושות ". מיוצר עם הרכיבים הטובים ביותר של מזון אמיתי ככל האפשר, כולל צ'דר לבן טוב מספיק כדי להביא הביתה לארוחת ערב. אחרי הכל, הכל טוב יותר עם גבינה.

Als Dan und ich zum ersten Mal in unserer Mankato-Garage angefangen haben, wollten wir unseren Kindern den Wert der harten Arbeit beibringen und ein wenig Spaß auf dem Weg haben. Wir wollten auch einen Snack, den wir uns gut fühlten, um sie zu füttern. Sehr aromatische Snacks aus echten, einfachen Zutaten – Sie wissen, Zutaten, die Sie nicht Ihr Gesicht knistern müssen, um zu sagen. Snacks voller Positivität, nicht schuldig. Snacks, die die Freude am täglichen Snack (und Snacks und Snacking...). Mit hellen Taschen, die die ganze Liebe und den Spaß ausstrahlen, der von Anfang an in sie gelangt. Schließlich geht es nicht darum, was ein Snack sein sollte? Mehr konnten wir nicht zustimmen. Genießen! XO, Angie The Real Art. Cremig, würzig, "Kuh-Geschenk an die Menschheit" käsig. description: Our small white popcorn kernels when popped create a light and tender puff with less hulls for easier eating. The popcorn comes in a beautiful glass half gallon canister. You can replenish the jar with our refill bag or it can be used for anything you can imagine. Virtually Hulless = very few hulls compared to "regular" popcorn. The "hull" is very thin and in most cases shatters when it pops. Any hulls that might remain on the popcorn after popping are thinner, finer and easily chewed and broken down further when you eat the popcorn. Please note that there is no 100% hulless popcorn. All popcorn must have a hull/skin (in technical terms it is the pericarp) in order to hold in the moisture/steam that is generated when cooking. It's the steam buildup that creates the pressure inside the kernel that causes the popcorn to pop. Popping method also plays a large part in how many hulls remain. If the oil/heat combination is not correct and the popcorn pops at a lower than optimal temperature, then many of the hulls will stay on the popcorn rather than shattering and breaking off. This gourmet hulless white popcorn also pops up larger than other hulless popcorn varieties. It is loved by all, but is an especially excellent choice for popcorn fans who wear braces or dentures, or who otherwise need to avoid hulls.

description:
Grown in Colorado… Popped in North Dakota!

Colorado Jack is owned and operated by a 4th generation farm family. The family operates processing plants that handle dry edible beans and barley in North Dakota. In 2013 they entered a partnership that purchased a facility in Colorado that processes beans as well as raw popcorn. Searching for a way to diversify and sell more of their popcorn they decided to enter the business of pre-popped flavored popcorn, and Colorado Jack was formed. The name paying tribute to the business in Colorado – Jack’s Bean Company, which has been in operation since 1932.

Jack’s Bean Company is dedicated to growing, processing and delivering high quality popcorn kernels. This dedication begins with the varieties chosen to plant and continues on through the harvest season with close contact with their growers. The popcorn varieties that Colorado Jack uses provide a large pop that are well suited for our unique blends of seasonings.

Our popcorn is grown in Colorado and Nebraska and then the raw kernels are shipped to facilities in North Dakota for popping and flavoring.

Colorado Jack is a small company based on the values and principles of giving back. Thank you for reading our story and we hope you enjoy Colorado Jack Popcorn. We are farmer-grown and here to stay!

description: Water lily seeds, also known as makhana, are a super food snack. They contain 65% less fat, 2X the amount of protein, and various nutrients. Water lily seeds, or makhana, are a superfood snack that have been eaten in India for thousands of years and are commonly known as the "healthier popcorn". Preparation Suggestion

-Caramel Popcorn-


Ingredients:
1 cup butter
2 cups brown sugar
1/2 cup corn syrup
1 teaspoon salt
1/2 teaspoon baking soda
1 teaspoon vanilla extract
5 quarts popped popcorn


Method:


1- Preheat oven to 250 degrees F (95 degrees C). Place popcorn in a very large bowl.

2-In a medium saucepan over medium heat, melt butter. Stir in brown sugar, corn syrup and salt. Bring to a boil, stirring constantly. Boil without stirring 4 minutes. Remove from heat and stir in soda and vanilla. Pour in a thin stream over popcorn, stirring to coat.


3-Place in two large shallow baking dishes and bake in preheated oven, stirring every 15 minutes, for 1 hour. Remove from oven and let cool completely before breaking into pieces.


Storage instructions:

Always store in dry, cool place away from sunlight and any sources of pollution and chemicals, in low temperature that doesn't exceed 20°.

description:
BETTER MADE SPECIAL POTATO CHIPS HISTORY
Cross and Peters company was founded on August 1st, 1930. The company was named after the founders' first names, Cross and Peter. Both set goals to make a better potato chip, hence the brand name: Better Made Potato Chips

Better Made became not only a brand name but a way of doing business. Even in the early days of the company, only the best ingredients and methods were used. At first, production was simple. Burlap bagged, select potatoes were cooked in the best oil available, weighed, and hand packed into crude, greaseless bags. Distribution was chiefly through the company's own store outlets, which later grew into small delivery routes.

OUR PROCESS TODAY
Today, Better Made uses 60 million pounds of chip potatoes every year and the entire process is a little more complex. The potatoes are purchased in bulk (45,000 to 85,000 pounds per truck load) and unloaded from delivery trucks which are lifted by a hydraulic lift. The potatoes are then transported by conveyors to storage bins. As needed the potatoes are automatically conveyed to the fryers where they are washed, peeled, sliced, and inspected. Next, the potato slices are conveyed to temperature-controlled cookers where only 100% cottonseed oil is used. The cooked chips are then lightly salted and automatically advanced by an overhead vibrating conveyor system to automatic packaging machines that weigh, form, fill, and seal the finished bags.

Better Made's over 85 years of progress have all been made in Detroit, using Michigan potatoes for ten months of the year and drawing from Mother Nature's harvest schedule in Florida, Missouri, Indiana, North Dakota, Minnesota, or wherever the best potatoes are available for the remainder of the year.

description:
BETTER MADE SPECIAL POTATO CHIPS HISTORY
Cross and Peters company was founded on August 1st, 1930. The company was named after the founders' first names, Cross and Peter. Both set goals to make a better potato chip, hence the brand name: Better Made Potato Chips

Better Made became not only a brand name but a way of doing business. Even in the early days of the company, only the best ingredients and methods were used. At first, production was simple. Burlap bagged, select potatoes were cooked in the best oil available, weighed, and hand packed into crude, greaseless bags. Distribution was chiefly through the company's own store outlets, which later grew into small delivery routes.

OUR PROCESS TODAY
Today, Better Made uses 60 million pounds of chip potatoes every year and the entire process is a little more complex. The potatoes are purchased in bulk (45,000 to 85,000 pounds per truck load) and unloaded from delivery trucks which are lifted by a hydraulic lift. The potatoes are then transported by conveyors to storage bins. As needed the potatoes are automatically conveyed to the fryers where they are washed, peeled, sliced, and inspected. Next, the potato slices are conveyed to temperature-controlled cookers where only 100% cottonseed oil is used. The cooked chips are then lightly salted and automatically advanced by an overhead vibrating conveyor system to automatic packaging machines that weigh, form, fill, and seal the finished bags.

Better Made's over 85 years of progress have all been made in Detroit, using Michigan potatoes for ten months of the year and drawing from Mother Nature's harvest schedule in Florida, Missouri, Indiana, North Dakota, Minnesota, or wherever the best potatoes are available for the remainder of the year.

What size portion pack should I buy?

With USA's ever expanding waistline, it is getting more difficult to calculate portion sizes. The typical service is 1 ounce of popcorn. . . I don't know about you, but 1 ounce isn't much. I have family of 5 and we typically use the 8 ounce package. If it is just my wife and I, we will toss in the 4 ounce packet.

How much popcorn does each pack make?

4 Ounce Portion Pack: Makes about 5 quarts per cycle. Serves 2-4.

6 Ounce Portion Pack: Makes about 7.5 quarts per cycle. Serves 4-8.

8 Ounce Portion Pack: Makes about 10 quarts per cycle. Serves 5-10.

Can I use a 4 ounce pouch in an 8 ounce kettle?

YES, it is OK to use a 4 ounce portion pack in an 8 ounce kettle. In fact, we recommend it if you don't need that much corn.

description:
Do you remember old-fashioned, buttered popcorn? Like the popcorn you can still get at movie theatres? We do. In fact, we used to make it. It was heavy on buttery topping and other artificial flavors. Our fans asked us for something with less topping, but with that same great taste, and we came up with Skinny Pop - skinny on ingredients! SkinnyPop starts with a premium popcorn kernel, sunflower oil and the perfect amount of salt. From there, Pure Popped Perfection says it all. Our popcorn has no GMOs, gluten or preservatives, making SkinnyPop a tasty, guilt-free snack. We believe in snacking without compromise. To us, that means using the fewest, cleanest and simplest ingredients possible to bring you the best tasting popcorn. Popcorn is a whole grain food - it contains the entire kernel. Because of this, it is high in fiber, rich in nutrients and has a low glycemic index. There is "no artificial anything" in our products - meaning we do not add any artificial or synthetic ingredients, colors, flavors, or preservatives to them. – That’s the Skinny!

¿Te acuerdas de palomitas de maíz anticuadas con mantequilla? ¿Como las palomitas de maíz que todavía puedes conseguir en las salas de cine? Nosotros sí. De hecho, solíamos hacerlo. Fue pesado en el topping mantequilloso y otros sabores artificiales. Nuestros fans nos pidieron algo con menos cobertura, pero con ese mismo gran sabor, y se nos ocurrió Skinny Pop - flaco en ingredientes! SkinnyPop comienza con un grano de palomitas de maíz premium, aceite de girasol y la cantidad perfecta de sal. A partir de ahí, Pure Popped Perfection lo dice todo. Nuestras palomitas de maíz no tienen transgénicos, gluten ni conservantes, lo que convierte a SkinnyPop en un bocadillo sabroso y sin culpa. Creemos en la merienda sin compromiso. Para nosotros, eso significa utilizar los menos ingredientes limpios y simples posibles para traerle las mejores palomitas de maíz. Las palomitas de maíz es un alimento de grano entero - contiene todo el núcleo. Debido a esto, es alto en fibra, rico en nutrientes y tiene un bajo índice glucémico. No hay "nada artificial" en nuestros productos, lo que significa que no les agregamos ningún ingrediente artificial o sintético, colores, sabores o conservantes. – ¡Ese es el Flaco!

האם אתם זוכרים פופקורן מיושן, עם חמאה? כמו הפופקורן שאתה עדיין יכול להשיג בבתי קולנוע? אנחנו עושים. למעשה, היינו עושים את זה. הוא היה כבד על ציפוי חמאה וטעמים מלאכותיים אחרים. המעריצים שלנו ביקשו מאיתנו משהו עם פחות ציפוי, אבל עם אותו טעם נהדר, ומצאנו את סקיני Pop - סקיני על המרכיבים! SkinnyPop מתחיל עם גרעיני פופקורן מובחרים, שמן חמניות וכמות מלח מושלמת. משם, Pure Popped Perfection אומר הכל. לפופקורן שלנו אין הנדסה גנטית, גלוטן או חומרים משמרים, מה שהופך את SkinnyPop לחטיף טעים ונטול אשמה. אנו מאמינים בחטיפים ללא פשרות. לנו, זה אומר שימוש במרכיבים הנמוכים ביותר, הנקיים והפשוטים ביותר האפשריים כדי להביא לכם את הפופקורן בטעם הטוב ביותר. פופקורן הוא מזון דגנים מלאים - הוא מכיל את כל הגרעינים. בגלל זה, הוא עשיר בסיבים, עשיר בחומרים מזינים ויש לו אינדקס גליקמי נמוך. אין "שום דבר מלאכותי" במוצרים שלנו - כלומר אנחנו לא מוסיפים שום רכיבים מלאכותיים או סינתטיים, צבעים, טעמים או חומרים משמרים אליהם. - זה הסקיני!

Erinnern Sie sich an altmodisches, gebuttertes Popcorn? Wie das Popcorn, das Sie immer noch in Kinokinos bekommen können? Wir tun. In der Tat haben wir es verwendet. Es war schwer auf butterartigem Belag und anderen künstlichen Aromen. Unsere Fans fragten uns nach etwas mit weniger Topping, aber mit dem gleichen großartigen Geschmack, und wir haben Skinny Pop – dünne Zutaten. SkinnyPop beginnt mit einem Premium-Popcornkörner, Sonnenblumenöl und der perfekten Menge an Salz. Von dort ist Pure Popped Perfection alles dabei. Unser Popcorn hat keine GVO, Gluten oder Konservierungsstoffe, was SkinnyPop zu einem leckeren und schuldfreien Snack macht. Wir glauben an Snacks ohne Kompromisse. Für uns bedeutet dies, die wenigen, saubersten und einfachsten Zutaten zu verwenden, um Ihnen das bestmögliche Geschmackspopcorn zu bieten. Popcorn ist ein Vollkornfutter - es enthält den gesamten Kern. Aus diesem Grund ist es reich an Ballaststoffen, reich an Nährstoffen und hat einen niedrigen glykämischen Index. Es gibt "nichts künstliches" in unseren Produkten – d.h. wir fügen ihnen keine künstlichen oder synthetischen Inhaltsstoffe, Farben, Aromen oder Konservierungsstoffe hinzu. – Das ist die Skinny!

您还记得老式黄油爆米花吗? 像爆米花一样,您仍然可以在电影院买到? 我们做到。 事实上,我们习惯制作它。 它对黄油顶部和其他人造香料非常沉重。 我们的粉丝要求我们寻找较少的东西,但同样的口味,我们推出了紧身的 Pop - 紧身的配料! SkinnyPop 从优质爆米花仁、向日葵油和适量盐开始。 从那里,Pure Popped Perfection 就是一切。 我们的爆米花不含转基因成分、麸质和防腐剂,使 SkinnyPop 成为美味、无罪恶的零食。 我们坚信零食,不妥协。 对我们来说,这意味着使用最少,最干净和最简单的配料,为您带来美味的爆米花。 爆米花是一种全谷物食品 - 它含有整个玉米粒。 因此,它富含纤维,营养丰富,血糖指数低。 我们的产品中没有"人工任何"——这意味着我们不会为它们添加任何人工或合成成分、颜色、香料或防腐剂。 – 这就是皮肤!

您記得老舊的黃油爆米花嗎? 就像爆米花一樣,您還可以在電影院吃嗎? 我們有。 事實上,我們曾經製作過。 它對奶油醬和其他人造香料很重。 我們的粉絲要求我們一些少但有相同品味的東西,我們想出了 Skinny Pop - 非常注重食材! SkinnyPop 以優質的爆米花、向日葵油和完美的鹽量開始。 從那裡,Pure Popped Perfection 為您說明一切。 我們的爆米花不含轉基因、麩質或防腐劑,使 SkinnyPop 成為美味、無內疚的零食。 我們相信零食毫不妥協。 對我們來說,這意味著使用最少、最乾淨、最簡單的成分來為您帶來最美味的爆米花。 爆米花是一種全穀物食物 - 它包含整個玉米粒。 因此,它富含纖維,富含營養素,並具有低血糖指數。 我們的產品中沒有「人造材料」 - 這意味著我們不為其添加任何人造或合成成分、色素、香料或防腐劑。 – 這就是瘦肉!

복고풍 버터 팝콘을 기억하십니까? 영화관에서 여전히 얻을 수 있는 팝콘처럼? 저희도 그렇습니다. 사실, 우리는 그것을 만들었습니다. 버터 토핑 및 기타 인공 향료에 무겁습니다. 저희 팬들은 토핑이 적은 것을 요청했지만 같은 맛이 좋은 스키니 팝 (Skinny Pop)을 내놓았습니다. description: Grown in Colorado? Popped in North Dakota! Colorado Jack is owned and operated by a 4th generation farm family. The name paying tribute to the business in Colorado ? Jack?s Bean Company, which has been in operation since 1932. Jack?s Bean Company is dedicated to growing, processing and delivering high quality popcorn kernels. This dedication begins with the varieties chosen to plant and continues on through the harvest season with close contact with their growers. The popcorn varieties that Colorado Jack uses provide a large pop that are well suited for our unique blends of seasonings. Our popcorn is grown in Colorado and Nebraska and then the raw kernels are shipped to facilities in North Dakota for popping and flavoring. Colorado Jack is a small company based on the values and principles of giving back. Thank you for reading our story and we hope you enjoy Colorado Jack Popcorn. We are farmer-grown and here to stay!

Northwest Expressions

From our Farm

Country Spoon and its products were created as a way for us to share the products that we grow on our farm with like-minded consumers around the country. Our farm, Rowley's South Ridge Farms, is located in the high mountain valleys of Utah. It is in these valleys that our fruit orchards are grown using time tested principles and techniques that have been passed down for generations. Our fruit is grown at high elevation, close to the sun, in fertile soils, and watered from a mountain creek, factors that all play a part in creating excellent fruit. We take pride in the way that our fruit is grown and processed and feel that it shows in the end products quality.

description:
We’re serious about being mindful. And as you can tell, we’re also serious about snacking. Nothing goes into our snacks that we wouldn’t feed our own families. That’s our mantra and it’s 100% the truth. It all started with a hunger—not just for satisfying snacks, but for ones made without the typical processed stuff you usually find on grocery store shelves. LesserEvil was born from a desire to make sinfully tasty snacks with clean, sustainable ingredients. And at our factory in Danbury, Connecticut, we control every single thing that goes into them, from organic, grass-fed ghee and Himalayan pink salt to cold pressed avocado oil. Some call it obsessive, but we find it oddly satisfying. Consider it an East Coast kind of Zen.

אנחנו רציניים לגבי תשומת לב. וכפי שאתם יכולים לומר, אנחנו גם רציניים לגבי חטיפים. שום דבר לא נכנס לחטיפים שלנו שלא היינו מאכילים את המשפחות שלנו. זו המנטרה שלנו והיא 100% האמת. הכל התחיל ברעב – לא רק לחטיפים מספקים, אלא גם עבור אלה שנעשו ללא דברים מעובדים טיפוסיים שאתה מוצא בדרך כלל על מדפי חנויות מכולת. LesserEvil נולדה מתוך רצון להכין חטיפים טעימים בצורה חטא עם מרכיבים נקיים וברי קיימא. ובמפעל שלנו בדנבורי, קונטיקט, אנו שולטים בכל דבר שנכנס לתוכו, מגהיי אורגני, מזין דשא ומלח ורוד הימלאיה ועד שמן אבוקדו בכבישה קרה. יש הקוראים לזה אובססיבי, אבל אנחנו מוצאים את זה מספק. חשבו על זה סוג החוף המזרחי של זן.

Wir machen es ernst, achtsam zu sein. Und wie Sie sagen können, sind wir auch ernst mit Snacks. Nichts geht in unsere Snacks, dass wir unsere eigenen Familien nicht füttern würden. Das ist unser Mantra und es ist 100% die Wahrheit. Alles begann mit einem Hunger – nicht nur für die Befriedigung von Snacks, sondern für diejenigen, die ohne die typischen verarbeiteten Sachen gemacht werden, die man normalerweise in den Lebensmittelgeschäften findet. LesserEvil entstand aus dem Wunsch, sündhaft leckere Snacks mit sauberen, nachhaltigen Zutaten herzustellen. Und in unserer Fabrik in Danbury, Connecticut, kontrollieren wir jedes einzelne Ding, das in sie hineingeht, von biologischem Ghee und Himalaya-Salz bis hin zu kaltgepresstem Avocadoöl. Manche nennen es obsessiv, aber wir finden es seltsam befriedigend. Betrachten Sie es als eine Art von Zen.

نحن جادون بشأن أن نكون في ذهن. وكما يمكنك أن تقول نحن أيضًا جادين بشأن تناول الوجبات الخفيفة. لا شيء يذهب إلى الوجبات الخفيفة التي لن نطعم عائلاتنا. هذا هو مانترا لدينا وهو الحقيقة بنسبة 100%. بدأ الأمر كله بالجوع - ليس فقط للوجبات الخفيفة المرضية ولكن للوجبات الخفيفة المصنوعة بدون المواد المعالجة التقليدية التي تجدها عادة على رفوف متجر البقالة. ولدت ليسر ايفل من الرغبة في صنع وجبات خفيفة لذيذة بمكونات نظيفة ومستدامة. وفي مصنعنا في دانبري بولاية كونيتيكت، نتحكم في كل شيء يذهب إليه، بدءًا من السمنة العضوية التي تغذي الأعشاب وملح الهيمالايا الوردي إلى زيت الأفوكادو المضغوط على البارد. البعض يسميه مهووس، لكننا نجده مرضي للغاية. اعتبر هذا النوع من منتجات زين من الساحل الشرقي.

description: This is a fun popcorn for people who can't make up their minds. It's a unique blend of several of our popcorn brands, delicious and great for eating or decorating your countertops. Does hulless popcorn mean it contains no hulls? In a word, no. Every kernel of popping corn has a seed coat that helps trap pressure inside the kernel during the cooking process—it’s largely responsible for that wonderful “pop” sound. Hulless popcorn refers to kernels that are smaller than typical corn kernels. The result is uniquely tender, fluffy popcorn with no irritating pieces to get stuck in your teeth and gums. If you’re new to hulless popcorn, you’ll wonder why you didn’t try it sooner. In 1965 in the rural community of Berne, Indiana, Roy Lehman planted a small plot of corn for his son, Brian—just for popping. Nearly 50 years later, Brian is still passionate about popcorn. 100% Natural for a Guilt-Free Snack. description:
BETTER MADE SPECIAL POTATO CHIPS HISTORY
Cross and Peters company was founded on August 1st, 1930. The company was named after the founders' first names, Cross and Peter. Both set goals to make a better potato chip, hence the brand name: Better Made Potato Chips

Better Made became not only a brand name but a way of doing business. Even in the early days of the company, only the best ingredients and methods were used. At first, production was simple. Burlap bagged, select potatoes were cooked in the best oil available, weighed, and hand packed into crude, greaseless bags. Distribution was chiefly through the company's own store outlets, which later grew into small delivery routes.

OUR PROCESS TODAY
Today, Better Made uses 60 million pounds of chip potatoes every year and the entire process is a little more complex. The potatoes are purchased in bulk (45,000 to 85,000 pounds per truck load) and unloaded from delivery trucks which are lifted by a hydraulic lift. The potatoes are then transported by conveyors to storage bins. As needed the potatoes are automatically conveyed to the fryers where they are washed, peeled, sliced, and inspected. Next, the potato slices are conveyed to temperature-controlled cookers where only 100% cottonseed oil is used. The cooked chips are then lightly salted and automatically advanced by an overhead vibrating conveyor system to automatic packaging machines that weigh, form, fill, and seal the finished bags.

Better Made's over 85 years of progress have all been made in Detroit, using Michigan potatoes for ten months of the year and drawing from Mother Nature's harvest schedule in Florida, Missouri, Indiana, North Dakota, Minnesota, or wherever the best potatoes are available for the remainder of the year.

description:
BETTER MADE SPECIAL POTATO CHIPS HISTORY
Cross and Peters company was founded on August 1st, 1930. The company was named after the founders' first names, Cross and Peter. Both set goals to make a better potato chip, hence the brand name: Better Made Potato Chips

Better Made became not only a brand name but a way of doing business. Even in the early days of the company, only the best ingredients and methods were used. At first, production was simple. Burlap bagged, select potatoes were cooked in the best oil available, weighed, and hand packed into crude, greaseless bags. Distribution was chiefly through the company's own store outlets, which later grew into small delivery routes.

OUR PROCESS TODAY
Today, Better Made uses 60 million pounds of chip potatoes every year and the entire process is a little more complex. The potatoes are purchased in bulk (45,000 to 85,000 pounds per truck load) and unloaded from delivery trucks which are lifted by a hydraulic lift. The potatoes are then transported by conveyors to storage bins. As needed the potatoes are automatically conveyed to the fryers where they are washed, peeled, sliced, and inspected. Next, the potato slices are conveyed to temperature-controlled cookers where only 100% cottonseed oil is used. The cooked chips are then lightly salted and automatically advanced by an overhead vibrating conveyor system to automatic packaging machines that weigh, form, fill, and seal the finished bags.

Better Made's over 85 years of progress have all been made in Detroit, using Michigan potatoes for ten months of the year and drawing from Mother Nature's harvest schedule in Florida, Missouri, Indiana, North Dakota, Minnesota, or wherever the best potatoes are available for the remainder of the year.

description:
BETTER MADE SPECIAL POTATO CHIPS HISTORY
Cross and Peters company was founded on August 1st, 1930. The company was named after the founders' first names, Cross and Peter. Both set goals to make a better potato chip, hence the brand name: Better Made Potato Chips

Better Made became not only a brand name but a way of doing business. Even in the early days of the company, only the best ingredients and methods were used. At first, production was simple. Burlap bagged, select potatoes were cooked in the best oil available, weighed, and hand packed into crude, greaseless bags. Distribution was chiefly through the company's own store outlets, which later grew into small delivery routes.

OUR PROCESS TODAY
Today, Better Made uses 60 million pounds of chip potatoes every year and the entire process is a little more complex. The potatoes are purchased in bulk (45,000 to 85,000 pounds per truck load) and unloaded from delivery trucks which are lifted by a hydraulic lift. The potatoes are then transported by conveyors to storage bins. As needed the potatoes are automatically conveyed to the fryers where they are washed, peeled, sliced, and inspected. Next, the potato slices are conveyed to temperature-controlled cookers where only 100% cottonseed oil is used. The cooked chips are then lightly salted and automatically advanced by an overhead vibrating conveyor system to automatic packaging machines that weigh, form, fill, and seal the finished bags.

Better Made's over 85 years of progress have all been made in Detroit, using Michigan potatoes for ten months of the year and drawing from Mother Nature's harvest schedule in Florida, Missouri, Indiana, North Dakota, Minnesota, or wherever the best potatoes are available for the remainder of the year.

From popcorn brownies to baked caramel popcorn, your purchase includes 15 mouthwatering recipes to inspire your taste buds and your imagination. Does hulless popcorn mean it contains no hulls? In a word, no. Every kernel of popping corn has a seed coat that helps trap pressure inside the kernel during the cooking process—it’s largely responsible for that wonderful “pop” sound. Hulless popcorn refers to kernels that are smaller than typical corn kernels. The result is uniquely tender, fluffy popcorn with no irritating pieces to get stuck in your teeth and gums. From the farm kitchen of Harry and Fairy Martin, back in 1941, a unique potato chip found its way into the hearts and homes of York County. Business soon outgrew the kitchen. The Martini's built a small factory and expanded their distribution from delivering fresh daily to market stands, to also selling to mom and pop grocery stores.

Using only the best chipping potatoes and maintaining high quality oils for frying are just two of the many factors that make Martin's Potato Chips taste so great. Having a dedicated and motivated workforce has been the most important ingredient for our success over the years.

All potato chips and popcorn are made in our 75,000 sq. ft. Thomasville facility which produces over one million bags each month. Other products distributed include Wege pretzels and a full line of corn products that are made locally for Martin's.

Some call it obsessive, but we find it oddly satisfying. Consider it an East Coast kind of Zen.

description:
BETTER MADE SPECIAL POTATO CHIPS HISTORY
Cross and Peters company was founded on August 1st, 1930. The company was named after the founders' first names, Cross and Peter. Both set goals to make a better potato chip, hence the brand name: Better Made Potato Chips

Better Made became not only a brand name but a way of doing business. Even in the early days of the company, only the best ingredients and methods were used. At first, production was simple. Burlap bagged, select potatoes were cooked in the best oil available, weighed, and hand packed into crude, greaseless bags. Distribution was chiefly through the company's own store outlets, which later grew into small delivery routes.

OUR PROCESS TODAY
Today, Better Made uses 60 million pounds of chip potatoes every year and the entire process is a little more complex. The potatoes are purchased in bulk (45,000 to 85,000 pounds per truck load) and unloaded from delivery trucks which are lifted by a hydraulic lift. The potatoes are then transported by conveyors to storage bins. As needed the potatoes are automatically conveyed to the fryers where they are washed, peeled, sliced, and inspected. Next, the potato slices are conveyed to temperature-controlled cookers where only 100% cottonseed oil is used. The cooked chips are then lightly salted and automatically advanced by an overhead vibrating conveyor system to automatic packaging machines that weigh, form, fill, and seal the finished bags.

Better Made's over 85 years of progress have all been made in Detroit, using Michigan potatoes for ten months of the year and drawing from Mother Nature's harvest schedule in Florida, Missouri, Indiana, North Dakota, Minnesota, or wherever the best potatoes are available for the remainder of the year.

description:
Handmade Artisan Toffee Popcorn

ToffeePop toffee covered popcorn is one of Northwest Expressions most requested gourmet confections, and is handmade by mixing our own signature Butter Crunch Almond Toffee, petite peanuts and fluffy mushroom popped corn. Betcha can’t eat just one handful!

It all starts with a 20” x 16” copper kettle over an open flame, and an old fashioned recipe using only the highest quality, all natural ingredients. The fresh sweet cream butter, pure sugars and roasted almonds are all slowly heated to the perfect temperature to create a gourmet toffee that is then added to peanuts and popcorn…and voila! ToffeePop popcorn! Our toffee popcorn is handmade with kosher dairy products, and gluten free, all natural ingredients, and we don’t skimp – each popcorn kernel is thoroughly coated with toffee crunch goodness.

Gourmet Gift Choice

Northwest Expressions

Crafting gourmet expressions influenced by the taste, feel and rich history of the Pacific Northwest, Northwest Expressions creates small batch artisan chocolates, cookies and confections made by hand and with love on Harstine Island in Washington State, USA. Our roots run deep. Rick’s Grandma Carrie’s original 1950’s handwritten recipe for Soft Peanut Butter Brittle still hangs in our kitchen. Though a bit tattered, it is framed now to preserve the recipe we still use to this very day.

description:
BETTER MADE SPECIAL POTATO CHIPS HISTORY
Cross and Peters company was founded on August 1st, 1930. The company was named after the founders' first names, Cross and Peter. Both set goals to make a better potato chip, hence the brand name: Better Made Potato Chips

Better Made became not only a brand name but a way of doing business. Even in the early days of the company, only the best ingredients and methods were used. At first, production was simple. Burlap bagged, select potatoes were cooked in the best oil available, weighed, and hand packed into crude, greaseless bags. Distribution was chiefly through the company's own store outlets, which later grew into small delivery routes.

OUR PROCESS TODAY
Today, Better Made uses 60 million pounds of chip potatoes every year and the entire process is a little more complex. The potatoes are purchased in bulk (45,000 to 85,000 pounds per truck load) and unloaded from delivery trucks which are lifted by a hydraulic lift. The potatoes are then transported by conveyors to storage bins. As needed the potatoes are automatically conveyed to the fryers where they are washed, peeled, sliced, and inspected. Next, the potato slices are conveyed to temperature-controlled cookers where only 100% cottonseed oil is used. The cooked chips are then lightly salted and automatically advanced by an overhead vibrating conveyor system to automatic packaging machines that weigh, form, fill, and seal the finished bags.

Better Made's over 85 years of progress have all been made in Detroit, using Michigan potatoes for ten months of the year and drawing from Mother Nature's harvest schedule in Florida, Missouri, Indiana, North Dakota, Minnesota, or wherever the best potatoes are available for the remainder of the year.

In a word, no. Every kernel of popping corn has a seed coat that helps trap pressure inside the kernel during the cooking process—it’s largely responsible for that wonderful “pop” sound. Hulless popcorn refers to kernels that are smaller than typical corn kernels. The result is uniquely tender, fluffy popcorn with no irritating pieces to get stuck in your teeth and gums. description: This hybrid pops medium to large, has its own flavor, yet it’s actually a little sweeter. Lately, it has been becoming many people’s favorite. There are not a lot of hulls. Does hulless popcorn mean it contains no hulls? In a word, no. Every kernel of popping corn has a seed coat that helps trap pressure inside the kernel during the cooking process—it’s largely responsible for that wonderful “pop” sound. Hulless popcorn refers to kernels that are smaller than typical corn kernels. The result is uniquely tender, fluffy popcorn with no irritating pieces to get stuck in your teeth and gums. description:
BETTER MADE SPECIAL POTATO CHIPS HISTORY
Cross and Peters company was founded on August 1st, 1930. The company was named after the founders' first names, Cross and Peter. Both set goals to make a better potato chip, hence the brand name: Better Made Potato Chips

Better Made became not only a brand name but a way of doing business. Even in the early days of the company, only the best ingredients and methods were used. At first, production was simple. Burlap bagged, select potatoes were cooked in the best oil available, weighed, and hand packed into crude, greaseless bags. Distribution was chiefly through the company's own store outlets, which later grew into small delivery routes.

OUR PROCESS TODAY
Today, Better Made uses 60 million pounds of chip potatoes every year and the entire process is a little more complex. The potatoes are purchased in bulk (45,000 to 85,000 pounds per truck load) and unloaded from delivery trucks which are lifted by a hydraulic lift. The potatoes are then transported by conveyors to storage bins. As needed the potatoes are automatically conveyed to the fryers where they are washed, peeled, sliced, and inspected. Next, the potato slices are conveyed to temperature-controlled cookers where only 100% cottonseed oil is used. The cooked chips are then lightly salted and automatically advanced by an overhead vibrating conveyor system to automatic packaging machines that weigh, form, fill, and seal the finished bags.

Better Made's over 85 years of progress have all been made in Detroit, using Michigan potatoes for ten months of the year and drawing from Mother Nature's harvest schedule in Florida, Missouri, Indiana, North Dakota, Minnesota, or wherever the best potatoes are available for the remainder of the year.

description:
We’re serious about being mindful. And as you can tell, we’re also serious about snacking. Nothing goes into our snacks that we wouldn’t feed our own families. That’s our mantra and it’s 100% the truth. It all started with a hunger—not just for satisfying snacks, but for ones made without the typical processed stuff you usually find on grocery store shelves. LesserEvil was born from a desire to make sinfully tasty snacks with clean, sustainable ingredients. And at our factory in Danbury, Connecticut, we control every single thing that goes into them, from organic, grass-fed ghee and Himalayan pink salt to cold pressed avocado oil. Some call it obsessive, but we find it oddly satisfying. Consider it an East Coast kind of Zen.

אנחנו רציניים לגבי תשומת לב. וכפי שאתם יכולים לומר, אנחנו גם רציניים לגבי חטיפים. שום דבר לא נכנס לחטיפים שלנו שלא היינו מאכילים את המשפחות שלנו. זו המנטרה שלנו והיא 100% האמת. הכל התחיל ברעב – לא רק לחטיפים מספקים, אלא גם עבור אלה שנעשו ללא דברים מעובדים טיפוסיים שאתה מוצא בדרך כלל על מדפי חנויות מכולת. LesserEvil נולדה מתוך רצון להכין חטיפים טעימים בצורה חטא עם מרכיבים נקיים וברי קיימא. ובמפעל שלנו בדנבורי, קונטיקט, אנו שולטים בכל דבר שנכנס לתוכו, מגהיי אורגני, מזין דשא ומלח ורוד הימלאיה ועד שמן אבוקדו בכבישה קרה. יש הקוראים לזה אובססיבי, אבל אנחנו מוצאים את זה מספק. חשבו על זה סוג החוף המזרחי של זן.

Wir machen es ernst, achtsam zu sein. Und wie Sie sagen können, sind wir auch ernst mit Snacks. Nichts geht in unsere Snacks, dass wir unsere eigenen Familien nicht füttern würden. Das ist unser Mantra und es ist 100% die Wahrheit. Alles begann mit einem Hunger – nicht nur für die Befriedigung von Snacks, sondern für diejenigen, die ohne die typischen verarbeiteten Sachen gemacht werden, die man normalerweise in den Lebensmittelgeschäften findet. LesserEvil entstand aus dem Wunsch, sündhaft leckere Snacks mit sauberen, nachhaltigen Zutaten herzustellen. Und in unserer Fabrik in Danbury, Connecticut, kontrollieren wir jedes einzelne Ding, das in sie hineingeht, von biologischem Ghee und Himalaya-Salz bis hin zu kaltgepresstem Avocadoöl. Manche nennen es obsessiv, aber wir finden es seltsam befriedigend. Betrachten Sie es als eine Art von Zen.

نحن جادون بشأن أن نكون في ذهن. وكما يمكنك أن تقول نحن أيضًا جادين بشأن تناول الوجبات الخفيفة. لا شيء يذهب إلى الوجبات الخفيفة التي لن نطعم عائلاتنا. هذا هو مانترا لدينا وهو الحقيقة بنسبة 100%. بدأ الأمر كله بالجوع - ليس فقط للوجبات الخفيفة المرضية ولكن للوجبات الخفيفة المصنوعة بدون المواد المعالجة التقليدية التي تجدها عادة على رفوف متجر البقالة. ولدت ليسر ايفل من الرغبة في صنع وجبات خفيفة لذيذة بمكونات نظيفة ومستدامة. وفي مصنعنا في دانبري بولاية كونيتيكت، نتحكم في كل شيء يذهب إليه، بدءًا من السمنة العضوية التي تغذي الأعشاب وملح الهيمالايا الوردي إلى زيت الأفوكادو المضغوط على البارد. البعض يسميه مهووس، لكننا نجده مرضي للغاية. اعتبر هذا النوع من منتجات زين من الساحل الشرقي.

Estamos sério sobre ser consciente. E como você pode dizer, também estamos a sério em lanches. Nada entra em nossos lanches que não alimentaríamos nossas próprias famílias. Esse é o nosso mantra e é 100% a verdade. Tudo começou com uma fome — não apenas para lanches satisfatórios, mas para aqueles feitos sem as coisas típicas processadas que você normalmente encontra nas prateleiras de supermercado. A LesserEvil nasceu a partir de um desejo de fazer lanches saborosos com ingredientes limpos e sustentáveis. E na nossa fábrica em Danbury, Connecticut, controlamos todas as coisas que entram, desde ghee orgânica, sal rosa do Himalaia até óleo de abacate prensado a frio. description:
BETTER MADE SPECIAL POTATO CHIPS HISTORY
Cross and Peters company was founded on August 1st, 1930. The company was named after the founders' first names, Cross and Peter. Both set goals to make a better potato chip, hence the brand name: Better Made Potato Chips

Better Made became not only a brand name but a way of doing business. Even in the early days of the company, only the best ingredients and methods were used. At first, production was simple. Burlap bagged, select potatoes were cooked in the best oil available, weighed, and hand packed into crude, greaseless bags. Distribution was chiefly through the company's own store outlets, which later grew into small delivery routes.

OUR PROCESS TODAY
Today, Better Made uses 60 million pounds of chip potatoes every year and the entire process is a little more complex. The potatoes are purchased in bulk (45,000 to 85,000 pounds per truck load) and unloaded from delivery trucks which are lifted by a hydraulic lift. The potatoes are then transported by conveyors to storage bins. As needed the potatoes are automatically conveyed to the fryers where they are washed, peeled, sliced, and inspected. Next, the potato slices are conveyed to temperature-controlled cookers where only 100% cottonseed oil is used. The cooked chips are then lightly salted and automatically advanced by an overhead vibrating conveyor system to automatic packaging machines that weigh, form, fill, and seal the finished bags.

Better Made's over 85 years of progress have all been made in Detroit, using Michigan potatoes for ten months of the year and drawing from Mother Nature's harvest schedule in Florida, Missouri, Indiana, North Dakota, Minnesota, or wherever the best potatoes are available for the remainder of the year.

description:
Handmade Artisan Toffee Popcorn

ToffeePop toffee covered popcorn is one of Northwest Expressions most requested gourmet confections, and is handmade by mixing our own signature Butter Crunch Almond Toffee, petite peanuts and fluffy mushroom popped corn. Betcha can’t eat just one handful!

It all starts with a 20” x 16” copper kettle over an open flame, and an old fashioned recipe using only the highest quality, all natural ingredients. The fresh sweet cream butter, pure sugars and roasted almonds are all slowly heated to the perfect temperature to create a gourmet toffee that is then added to peanuts and popcorn…and voila! ToffeePop popcorn! Our toffee popcorn is handmade with kosher dairy products, and gluten free, all natural ingredients, and we don’t skimp – each popcorn kernel is thoroughly coated with toffee crunch goodness.

Gourmet Gift Choice

Why not deliver the gourmet taste of homemade toffee popcorn to your friends and family? Hand crafting our confectionery using a small batch process ensures that old fashioned, homemade ‘melt in your mouth crunch’ and distinctive artisanal flavor of a truly handmade toffee popcorn, and an elegant resealable gallon canister keeps your popcorn in perfect condition.

Northwest Expressions

Crafting gourmet expressions influenced by the taste, feel and rich history of the Pacific Northwest, Northwest Expressions creates small-batch artisan chocolates, cookies and confections made by hand and with love on Harstine Island in Washington State, USA. Our roots run deep. Rick’s Grandma Carrie’s original 1950’s handwritten recipe for Soft Peanut Butter Brittle still hangs in our kitchen. Though a bit tattered, it is framed now to preserve the recipe we still use to this very day.

description:
Grown in Colorado… Popped in North Dakota!

Colorado Jack is owned and operated by a 4th generation farm family. The family operates processing plants that handle dry edible beans and barley in North Dakota. In 2013 they entered a partnership that purchased a facility in Colorado that processes beans as well as raw popcorn. Searching for a way to diversify and sell more of their popcorn they decided to enter the business of pre-popped flavored popcorn, and Colorado Jack was formed. The name paying tribute to the business in Colorado – Jack’s Bean Company, which has been in operation since 1932.

Jack’s Bean Company is dedicated to growing, processing and delivering high quality popcorn kernels. This dedication begins with the varieties chosen to plant and continues on through the harvest season with close contact with their growers. The popcorn varieties that Colorado Jack uses provide a large pop that are well suited for our unique blends of seasonings.

Our popcorn is grown in Colorado and Nebraska and then the raw kernels are shipped to facilities in North Dakota for popping and flavoring.

Colorado Jack is a small company based on the values and principles of giving back. Thank you for reading our story and we hope you enjoy Colorado Jack Popcorn. We are farmer-grown and here to stay!

description:
How we started it

In 2012 I and my wife were looking for a weekend business to fulfill our crazy working habit and tried to make some extra money beside our regular jobs. At the beginning we had tone of ideas but Kettle corn wasn't the first thing that came to our minds,  but eventually we picked it simply because it was one of our favorite snack in the whole list. Three months later we've decided to purchase all the equipments, popcorn bags, a big hand pop kettle and some propane gas that we needed. few weeks of practice later,  we started to popping our first batch of kettle corn in one of the biggest street fair in New York City and that was how it started in the very beginning.  In 2014 we open our first popcorn shop in Flushing New York, 2015 we opened two more popcorn carts in our neighborhood shopping mall.  

Keep it in tradition method : Mushroom Kernel + Hand Pop technique 

Every single popcorn kernel is hand popped in small batches by our popcorn chef. We want to keep the hand pop tradition, because it is simple way to coat the mushroom popcorn kernel with a tin layer of sugar coating.

Making a batch of kettle corn isn't easy at all, our chef has to stand next to a 450 degree red hot big kettle during the entire popping process and he has to constantly stir the popcorn kernels inside the big kettle  to make sure that the sugar and kernels won't get burn in a split of seconds.

Choosing the best popcorn kernel

We choose one of the best Non-GMO popcorn kernel seed from the entire United States by some of the best popcorn farmers in this country.

 How Do We get nearly perfect batch everytime?

Practice, practice and lots of practice or fail and fail and fail again and learn from all these failures.

Und in unserer Fabrik in Danbury, Connecticut, kontrollieren wir jedes einzelne Ding, das in sie hineingeht, von biologischem Ghee und Himalaya-Salz bis hin zu kaltgepresstem Avocadoöl. Manche nennen es obsessiv, aber wir finden es seltsam befriedigend. Betrachten Sie es als eine Art von Zen.

אנחנו רציניים לגבי תשומת לב. וכפי שאתם יכולים לומר, אנחנו גם רציניים לגבי חטיפים. שום דבר לא נכנס לחטיפים שלנו שלא היינו מאכילים את המשפחות שלנו. זו המנטרה שלנו והיא 100% האמת. הכל התחיל ברעב – לא רק לחטיפים מספקים, אלא גם עבור אלה שנעשו ללא דברים מעובדים טיפוסיים שאתה מוצא בדרך כלל על מדפי חנויות מכולת. LesserEvil נולדה מתוך רצון להכין חטיפים טעימים בצורה חטא עם מרכיבים נקיים וברי קיימא. ובמפעל שלנו בדנבורי, קונטיקט, אנו שולטים בכל דבר שנכנס לתוכו, מגהיי אורגני, מזין דשא ומלח ורוד הימלאיה ועד שמן אבוקדו בכבישה קרה. יש הקוראים לזה אובססיבי, אבל אנחנו מוצאים את זה מספק. חשבו על זה סוג החוף המזרחי של זן.

نحن جادون بشأن أن نكون في ذهن. وكما يمكنك أن تقول نحن أيضًا جادين بشأن تناول الوجبات الخفيفة. لا شيء يذهب إلى الوجبات الخفيفة التي لن نطعم عائلاتنا. هذا هو مانترا لدينا وهو الحقيقة بنسبة 100%. بدأ الأمر كله بالجوع - ليس فقط للوجبات الخفيفة المرضية ولكن للوجبات الخفيفة المصنوعة بدون المواد المعالجة التقليدية التي تجدها عادة على رفوف متجر البقالة. ولدت ليسر ايفل من الرغبة في صنع وجبات خفيفة لذيذة بمكونات نظيفة ومستدامة. وفي مصنعنا في دانبري بولاية كونيتيكت، نتحكم في كل شيء يذهب إليه، بدءًا من السمنة العضوية التي تغذي الأعشاب وملح الهيمالايا الوردي إلى زيت الأفوكادو المضغوط على البارد. البعض يسميه مهووس، لكننا نجده مرضي للغاية. اعتبر هذا النوع من منتجات زين من الساحل الشرقي.

Estamos sério sobre ser consciente. E como você pode dizer, também estamos a sério em lanches. Nada entra em nossos lanches que não alimentaríamos nossas próprias famílias. Esse é o nosso mantra e é 100% a verdade. Tudo começou com uma fome — não apenas para lanches satisfatórios, mas para aqueles feitos sem as coisas típicas processadas que você normalmente encontra nas prateleiras de supermercado. A LesserEvil nasceu a partir de um desejo de fazer lanches saborosos com ingredientes limpos e sustentáveis. E na nossa fábrica em Danbury, Connecticut, controlamos todas as coisas que entram, desde ghee orgânica, sal rosa do Himalaia até óleo de abacate prensado a frio. Alguns o chamam obsessivo, mas achamos estranhamente satisfatório. Considere um tipo de Zen na costa leste.

我们认真地了解身心。 正如你所说,我们也认真对待零食。 零食不会给我们的家庭喂食。 这是我们的口号,这就是真相。 这一切都始于饥饿——不仅是为了满足零食,而且对于那些没有通常在杂货店货架上找到的典型加工食品的制造产品。 LesserEvil 源于一个用干净、可持续的配料制作美味零食的愿望。 在我们位于康涅狄格州丹伯里的工厂,我们控制进入它们的每一件东西,从有机、草饲酥油、喜马拉雅粉盐到冷压鳄梨油。 有些人称其为痴迷,但我们发现它非常满意。 把它当作东海岸的禅宗。

description:
BETTER MADE SPECIAL POTATO CHIPS HISTORY
Cross and Peters company was founded on August 1st, 1930. The company was named after the founders' first names, Cross and Peter. Both set goals to make a better potato chip, hence the brand name: Better Made Potato Chips

Better Made became not only a brand name but a way of doing business. Even in the early days of the company, only the best ingredients and methods were used. At first, production was simple. Burlap bagged, select potatoes were cooked in the best oil available, weighed, and hand packed into crude, greaseless bags. Distribution was chiefly through the company's own store outlets, which later grew into small delivery routes.

OUR PROCESS TODAY
Today, Better Made uses 60 million pounds of chip potatoes every year and the entire process is a little more complex. The potatoes are purchased in bulk (45,000 to 85,000 pounds per truck load) and unloaded from delivery trucks which are lifted by a hydraulic lift. The potatoes are then transported by conveyors to storage bins. As needed the potatoes are automatically conveyed to the fryers where they are washed, peeled, sliced, and inspected. Next, the potato slices are conveyed to temperature-controlled cookers where only 100% cottonseed oil is used. The cooked chips are then lightly salted and automatically advanced by an overhead vibrating conveyor system to automatic packaging machines that weigh, form, fill, and seal the finished bags.

Better Made's over 85 years of progress have all been made in Detroit, using Michigan potatoes for ten months of the year and drawing from Mother Nature's harvest schedule in Florida, Missouri, Indiana, North Dakota, Minnesota, or wherever the best potatoes are available for the remainder of the year.

We were immediately frustrated by the lack of options in the marketplace that were both tasty AND healthy; so we set out to develop our own. After years of research (and many popcorn calories consumed!) we launched the Franklin’s brand. We believe in providing uncompromising quality and flavor, and always doing right by our customer.

So why coconut oil? There is no better fat on the planet for making popcorn than coconut oil. Not only is 100% Coconut Oil more healthy than other fats, but it is the ONLY way to recreate that decadent, delicious movie theatre popcorn taste without using actual butter.

title: Fresh MOVIE Like POPCORN KERNELS...Make at Home for Birthday Parties (4)

description: CORN :Corn is also known as maize and is a widely used grain plant. Most of the nutrients of corn come from the seeds or the kernels. These kernels range in color from white to bright yellow and orange, depending on which part of the world they are grown in. One of the most used variants of corn is sweet corn. This grain is used in multiple cuisines and can be cooked in many different ways. They are packed with nutrients that benefit your body. Ingredients 3 tablespoons Coconut Oil ½ cup popcorn kernels 3 tablespoons butter (or less, if you insist) Generous pinch of salt Directions 1.Pour oil into a heavy-bottomed (at least 3-quart) saucepan. Add 3 popcorn kernels, and turn the heat to medium-high. 2.Wait for all three kernels to pop. Add the rest of the kernels, cover, and remove pot from heat. Count to 30 -- it helps to count out loud. Very, very loud. 3.Return your pot to medium-high heat. Once the kernels begin to pop -- they should do so almost in unison, thanks to the wait time -- begin shaking the pan back and forth with the lid slightly ajar. Don't get so vigorous that the lid flies off, okay? 4.Once the popping slows -- 2 to 3 seconds between pops is fine -- turn off the heat and empty your popcorn into a large bowl. While your pan is still hot, slide your butter in there, and let it melt. Once it begins to brown, pour it over your popcorn, and toss with a wooden spoon or rubber spatula to combine. Sprinkle with a fat pinch of salt. Tip: Keep the kernels stored in an airtight container after opening, and they will keep for up to 2 years! You Can go ahead and find interesting ways to add corn to your meals also . Add to stir-fry’s or have as a chaat, blend into soups or make delicious corn and Palak kebabs for the youngsters this season. Happy eating!

description: Water lily seeds, also known as makhana, are a super food snack. They contain 65% less fat, 2X the amount of protein, and various nutrients. Water lily seeds, or makhana, are a superfood snack that have been eaten in India for thousands of years and are commonly known as the "healthier popcorn". Traditionally, they are prepared as a snack, roasted with ghee, salt, and Indian spices. Popped water lily seeds are a light and airy puffed snack, similar to popcorn (without the yucky kernels) containing more nutritional value than popcorn with a deeply satisfying crunch. They are a plant based super-food, low in calories and rich in nutrients. Water lily seeds are also found in Aruyveda- an eastern system of medicine which is based on the idea of balance in bodily systems. They are believed to have incredible benefits on the body due to their nutrient rich, low calorie, and anti-inflammatory properties. Water lily seeds are gluten free, corn free, grain free, vegan, low-fat, antioxidant.

description:
Back when Dan and I first started popping kettle corn in our Mankato, Minnesota garage, we wanted to teach our kids the value of hard work and have a little fun along the way. We also wanted a snack we felt good about feeding them. Hugely flavorful snacks made with real, simple ingredients -- you know, ingredients you don’t have to scrunch up your face to say. Snacks packed with positivity, not guilt. Snacks that keep the joy in everyday snacking (and snacking and snacking…). With bright bags that radiate all the love and fun that went into them from the beginning. After all, isn’t that what snacking should be about? We couldn’t agree more. Enjoy.

Cuando Dan y yo empezamos a hacer estallar maíz hervidor en nuestro garaje Mankato, Minnesota, queríamos enseñar a nuestros hijos el valor del trabajo duro y divertirnos un poco en el camino. También queríamos un aperitivo que nos sentimos bien al alimentarlos. Refrigerios muy sabrosos elaborados con ingredientes reales y sencillos. Ya sabes, ingredientes que no tienes que agitar tu cara para decirlo. Snacks llenos de positividad, no culpa. Aperitivos que mantienen la alegría en los bocadillos diarios (y bocadillos y aperitivos…). Con bolsas brillantes que irradian todo el amor y la diversión que entró en ellos desde el principio. Después de todo, ¿no es eso de lo que debería ser la merienda? No podríamos estar más de acuerdo. Disfrutar.

Als Dan und ich zum ersten Mal in unserer Mankato, Minnesota Garage angefangen haben, wollten wir unseren Kindern den Wert harter Arbeit beibringen und ein wenig Spaß auf dem Weg haben. Wir wollten auch einen Snack, den wir uns gut fühlten, um sie zu füttern. Sehr aromatische Snacks aus echten, einfachen Zutaten – Sie wissen, Zutaten, die Sie nicht Ihr Gesicht knistern müssen, um zu sagen. Snacks voller Positivität, nicht schuldig. Snacks, die die Freude am täglichen Snack (und Snacks und Snacking...). Mit hellen Taschen, die die ganze Liebe und den Spaß ausstrahlen, der von Anfang an in sie gelangt. Schließlich geht es nicht darum, was ein Snack sein sollte? Mehr konnten wir nicht zustimmen. Genießen!

כשדן ואני התחלנו לראשונה לקפוץ קומקום תירס בחניה Mankato, Minnesota שלנו, רצינו ללמד את הילדים שלנו את הערך של עבודה קשה וליהנות קצת לאורך הדרך. רצינו גם חטיף שהרגשנו טוב לגבי האכילה. חטיפים טעימים מאוד העשויים מרכיבים אמיתיים ופשוטים -- אתם יודעים, מרכיבים שאתם לא צריכים לגרד את הפנים שלכם כדי לומר. חטיפים מלאים בחיוביות, לא אשמה. חטיפים ששומרים על השמחה בנטיפים יומיומיים (וחטיפים וחטיפים..). עם תיקים בהירים המקרינים את כל האהבה והכיף שנכנסו אליהם מההתחלה. אחרי הכל, האם זה לא מה שיש לחטיפים לעלות? לא הצלחנו להסכים יותר. תהנה.

عندما بدأت دان وأنا لأول مرة في صنع غلاية الذرة في جراج مانكاتو بولاية مينيسوتا، أردنا تعليم أطفالنا قيمة العمل الشاق والاستمتاع قليلاً على طول الطريق. كما أردنا وجبة خفيفة شعرنا بالرضا بشأن طعامها. وجبات خفيفة لذيذة للغاية مصنوعة من مكونات حقيقية وبسيطة -- كما تعرف، مكونات لن تضطر إلى فرك وجهك لتقولها. الوجبات الخفيفة معبأة بإيجابية ولا تشعر بالذنب. الوجبات الخفيفة التي تحافظ على المتعة في الوجبات الخفيفة اليومية (والوجبات الخفيفة والوجبات الخفيفة....). مع حقائب مشرقة تشع كل الحب والمرح الذي سبق لهم من البداية. في النهاية، أليس هذا ما يجب أن يكون الوجبات الخفيفة؟ لا يمكننا الموافقة على المزيد. استمتع.

Quando Dan e eu começamos a estourar milho em nossa garagem Mankato, Minnesota, queríamos ensinar às nossas crianças o valor do trabalho duro e nos divertir um pouco ao longo do caminho. Também queríamos um lanche que nos sentissemos bem em alimentá-los. Lanches muito saborosos feitos com ingredientes reais e simples – você sabe, ingredientes que você não precisa mexer o seu rosto para dizer. Lanches repletos de positividade, sem culpa. Lanches que mantêm a alegria em lanches diários (e lanches e lanches...) Com bolsas brilhantes que irradiam todo o amor e diversão que os havia desde o início. Afinal, não é sobre isso que comer deve ser? Não conseguimos concordar mais. Aproveite.

description:
Handmade Artisan Toffee Popcorn

It all starts with a 20” x 16” copper kettle over an open flame, and an old fashioned recipe using only the highest quality, all natural ingredients. The fresh sweet cream butter, pure sugars and roasted almonds are all slowly heated to the perfect temperature to create a gourmet toffee that is then added to peanuts and popcorn…and voila! ToffeePop popcorn! Our toffee popcorn is handmade with kosher dairy products, and gluten free, all natural ingredients, and we don’t skimp – each popcorn kernel is thoroughly coated with toffee crunch goodness.

Gourmet Gift Choice

Northwest Expressions

Crafting gourmet expressions influenced by the taste, feel and rich history of the Pacific Northwest, Northwest Expressions creates small batch artisan chocolates, cookies and confections made by hand and with love on Harstine Island in Washington State, USA. Our roots run deep. Rick’s Grandma Carrie’s original 1950’s handwritten recipe for Soft Peanut Butter Brittle still hangs in our kitchen. Calico Popcorn (105 days) Open-pollinated. An heirloom dual-purpose corn with 5–8 ears that look like smaller versions of Indian corn. The shiny bright ears come in an array of colors, with red, yellow and mottled rosy-brown most common, but brown, purple, blue, white and other combinations possible. Kernels are smaller than those of most Indian corns, but larger than conventional popcorns. Calico is both decorative and edible so you can hang it on your door in fall and pop the very same batch on Thanksgiving. Growing: CAUTION: Untreated sweet corn seed will not germinate in cold wet soil. Heavy nitrogen requirements. Rows 3' apart, 4 seeds/ft. Thin to 1' apart. When corn is knee-high, side-dress with azomite or alfalfa meal to stimulate growth. description: Don't be fooled by some of the commercial versions of kettle corn on the market! What they call "kettle corn" is often a cheap grade of popcorn that is thrown into a massive hot-air popper, and then literally sprayed with a sweet/salty concoction made of who-knows-what! While the basic ingredients may be the same, different types of popcorn, oil, sugar and salt, as well as cooking methods and temperatures make a huge difference in the final taste! The secret to the taste of genuine kettle corn is in the cooking process itself. The popcorn must be popped in a very hot coating of cooking oil inside either a cast iron or stainless steel kettle. A mixture of finely granulated sugar is placed in the kettle at just the right time. As the popcorn pops, the sugar caramelizes in a fine layer on each kernel of corn. Unlike caramel corn, which is drenched in sweetness, kettle corn is lightly sweet and lightly salty. Other ingredients include hand-made dry-caramel, molasses and Thaitian vanilla bean caviar. PLEASE NOTE: There are absolutely no peanut or soy products, gluten, cholesterol, artificial flavors, colors or preservatives in Casey's Kettle Corn! Each bag holds 5 ounces of kettle corn and is shipped out in a case of 10!
